claims: Reassess and manage hypotension (recent systolic BP 89-99 mmHg, MAP 62-67 mmHg) with fluid resuscitation and hemodynamic monitoring.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (levofloxacin, metronidazole, oral vancomycin) and monitor for clinical improvement given leukocytosis (WBC up to 27.9 K/uL).
Repeat basic metabolic panel and magnesium to reassess hyponatremia (Na 128-133 mEq/L), hypocalcemia (total Ca 7.0-7.8 mg/dL), and prior hypomagnesemia.
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status on 4 L/min nasal cannula, with SpO2 desaturation limit set at 85-88%.
Reassess pain and continue multimodal analgesia as needed (recent pain level mild to moderate).
Implement fall precautions and maintain bed rest given high fall risk (history of falls, bedfast, IV access).
Perform aspiration precautions and oral care given mildly impaired swallow and increased secretions.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (Hgb 9.3-10.2 g/dL, Hct 28.7-32.3%) and transfuse if clinically indicated.
Recheck lactate (recent 2.4 mmol/L) to assess for ongoing hypoperfusion.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin 5000 units.
